completionPolicy.requires: All visible required core/branch choices and required text fields

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.intro
elements.html:
Test for uneven outcomes and keep consequential decisions reviewable.

An automated score can reflect data gaps, unsuitable goals, or biased patterns. A high average score can hide different error rates across groups. Ask who is affected, who can challenge a result, and whether automation belongs in the decision at all. In a small fictional test, identifying a disparity is a reason to investigate; it is not proof of one particular cause. People need a meaningful way to correct mistakes, not just a label saying a human is involved.

Practice scenario

Fictional club translation test: the tool meets the same prewritten meaning-preservation checklist for 18 of 20 standard-English notices, but 10 of 20 notices using a local dialect. Someone proposes using it alone to reject club applications.

choices.text: The tool is equally reliable for everyone.
Investigate the gap and avoid using it alone for exclusion.
Keep the tool unchanged because its combined score is above half.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.fairness.feedback.perfect
elements.html: The supplied groups have different observed results.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.fairness.feedback.investigate
elements.html: The gap warrants review; the test does not establish the cause or all future performance.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.fairness.feedback.blame
elements.html: An overall threshold can hide the different observed error rates.

choices.text: Let applicants correct errors and obtain review by someone able to change the decision.
Have a person automatically approve every machine result.
Hide the reason so nobody argues.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.appeal.feedback.appeal
elements.html: An appeal needs authority and a path to correction.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.appeal.feedback.rubber
elements.html: A rubber stamp does not provide independent judgment.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.appeal.feedback.hide
elements.html: That prevents challenge and repair.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.transfer
elements.title: Propose two checks before this tool is used again and one reason to choose a non-automated process.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l13.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Identifies the observed gap without inventing its cause.
  • Includes affected people or representative testing.
  • Provides meaningful review or justified non-use.

Twenty examples per group are limited evidence. Fairness is contextual, and this exercise does not certify a system or decide any real person’s eligibility.
